When you first sign up for Late League, your first 5 games will be your placement games.  Your win/loss record in these first 5 games determine your initial rank on the leaderboards. Each placement match adjusts your MMR using the following criteria:

     Amateur                    Pro
5-0 = Silver 1          5-0 = Plat 3
4-1 = Silver 2          4-1 = Gold 1
3-2 = Silver 3          3-2 = Gold 2
2-3 = Bronze 1        2-3 = Silver 2
1-4 = Bronze 2        1-4 = Bronze 1
0-5 = Bronze 3        0-5 = Bronze 3

Halo 3 is played on the map LL Sandbox NH found in RandyJacksonBK fileshare.

After a game make sure to:
1.Upload stats to discord bot
2.Correctly choose which team wins
3.Make sure sheet it correcly up to date
